podcast.body: Composed sometime between 1680 and 1706, this piece stands as Pachelbel's sole major hit, despite him having composed a vast quantity of music during his lifetime. Unless one is deeply immersed in classical music, it is unlikely they would be able to name another of his works. "And although he composed lots and lots and lots of music during his lifetime, that was his only hit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Great Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of the 90s: Part 2
